item.subject: science
item.stem:
The diagram shows two branches Aditya builds with the same constantan wire. Branch R uses one cell. Branch S uses two cells in series. He closes each switch for 4 minutes. He also thinks about heat in a toaster coil and heat in a shorted lamp flex.

Which claims correctly compare the heating and judge whether it is useful or harmful? One or more options may be correct.

options.A: The wire in S heats more than in R over the same 4 minutes.
options.B: That stronger heating can be useful in a toaster coil but harmful in a shorted lamp flex.
options.C: The wire in R heats more than in S because one cell always heats a wire more than two cells.
options.D: Neither branch generates heat because the constantan wire does not glow.
